config.description: Preregistered finite-size gate (report gate 5); see docs/FINITE_SIZE_GATE_PREREGISTRATION.md. Do not edit after the preregistration commit.

caveats: Gate tests recovery of known exponents to a stated accuracy, not a precision measurement.
One sampler and lattice convention; T is 3e-7 below exact Tc.
Exact references: finite-torus energy and its numerical T-derivative only; |m|, chi, Binder have none.
Exponent tolerances absorb corrections to scaling by assumption; fits use no correction terms.
